name: AquaDuct
summary: Dive into the sunken depths of the ancient AquaDuct. Oakley, the peaceful ancient moss turtle, is lost deep within the mystical submerged aqueducts of Aethelgard, where rising floodwaters threaten his path. Together with companions Lyra and Kael, guide Oakley safely through 1,000 soothing puzzle chambers back to sanctuary. The game blends classic isometric tile-matching with dynamic water mechanics: clear Sun Runes to step Oakley forward, Water Runes to lower the water level, and Life or Shield Runes for vital boosts, while companion spells charged by Shock Runes overcome obstacles.
